title: hieracium olivaceum subsp. praerosum
intro: Hieracium olivaceum subsp. praerosum, commonly known as a species of Hawkweed, is a plant that belongs to the dandelion family (Asteraceae) and is native to the UK. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including reducing inflammation and relieving pain, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium olivaceum subsp. praerosum include acting as an anti-inflammatory, an antioxidant, and a hepatoprotective agent, which may help protect the liver from damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
